title: HarborInspectionCommand
responsibility: Registers Harbor inspection, SDK app tooling, MCP stdio and verified testnet publication through the installed Harbor packages.

inputs.name: HarborInspectionCommand.register.program
inputs.description: The root Harness command that receives the Harbor command group.

outputs.name: HarborInspectionCommand.register
outputs.description: Adds Harbor version, chain info, agent and service status, runtime doctor, app templates, scaffold, check, pack, Android staging, a workspace-bound MCP stdio session and verified testnet publication.

inputs.name: registerHarborAppTools.run
inputs.description: The existing finite SDK app tooling runner.

outputs.name: registerHarborAppTools

inputs.name: installedEntry.sdk
inputs.description: Selects the SDK entry instead of the Harbor CLI entry.

outputs.name: installedEntry
outputs.description: An operator-selected, absolute JavaScript entry path.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The selected entry is empty, relative, or has an unsupported file extension.

outputs.name: nodeExecutable
outputs.description: An absolute Node executable from operator configuration or PATH.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: No acceptable absolute Node executable is available.

inputs.name: runtimeEnv.mode
inputs.description: The mode that selects the environment allowed for this process.

inputs.name: runtimeEnv.node
inputs.description: The selected absolute Node executable, forwarded in publish mode.

outputs.name: runtimeEnv
outputs.description: Allows runtime variables. SDK modes receive the current Harness entry, and publish receives the Harbor CLI and Node paths.

inputs.name: unsetIfEmpty.value
inputs.description: An environment value supplied by the caller.

outputs.name: unsetIfEmpty
outputs.description: Undefined for an empty or unset value, otherwise the original value.
